source: This is suitable for files that have to keep their names (e.g. {0}) *or* likely won't change (e.g. {1}).
text: Cela convient aux fichiers qui doivent conserver leur nom (par ex. {0}) *ou* qui ont peu de chances de changer (par ex. {1}).
